subject.title: feat(linux): Quick Chat streamed replies and precise pairing states

question: Should Linux Quick Chat intentionally expose streamed assistant output and make native gateway-auth recovery messaging the supported product path, including deferring setup-code/bootstrap-token redemption to a later UI flow?
rationale: The PR introduces a new user-facing native chat surface and establishes recovery semantics at the credential boundary; tests can validate mechanics but cannot decide the intended product boundary or deferred bootstrap experience.

options.title: Accept the scoped Quick Chat direction
options.body: Approve streamed replies and precise pairing/credential notices, while keeping setup-code and bootstrap-token redemption out of this PR.

options.title: Narrow to streaming only
options.body: Merge only the run-correlated streamed-reply path and track gateway-auth recovery wording/UI as a separate product decision.

options.title: Require complete bootstrap handling now
options.body: Pause this PR until the desired setup-code or bootstrap-token redemption product flow is defined and implemented.

recommendation.title: Accept the scoped Quick Chat direction
recommendation.body: Approve streamed replies and precise pairing/credential notices, while keeping setup-code and bootstrap-token redemption out of this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this person directly to the proposed Linux Quick Chat and gateway-boundary design.
